# #395 I1 — Local ATM destination-evidence handoff (plan only)

**Status:** Proposed minimal technical reconciliation; **no source/tests/contracts/tasks/SQL/mobile/generated files changed**. Immutable published implementation context: [`9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621`](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/packages/logic/src/account-review/review-schemas.ts). Normalizer producer consulted read-only at `85e40b6dbd4b7a486e087d4007c150597942f9aa` on `codex/395-normalization-worker`; producer may publish a successor. Ownership of `normalization.ts::prepareRow` and `normalization-evidence.ts` **remains with that normalizer owner**, not this report lane. Frozen T004/B1 product decisions remain unchanged; material rule changes HOLD.

## Decision: one canonical *local review-row* destination-proof field is required

**Reject the no-new-field alternative.** Provider SMS v2 already carries canonical nullable `toAccountEvidence` ([parser-schemas.ts:230–236](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/packages/logic/src/account-review/parser-schemas.ts#L230-L236)), and frozen [wire-shapes.md:79–100](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/specs/395-shared-account-review/contracts/wire-shapes.md#L79-L100) requires its grounding independently from source evidence. However current local [`commonReviewRow`:174–190](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/packages/logic/src/account-review/review-schemas.ts#L174-L190) retains only `accountEvidence` and `toAssignment`. The normalizer's [destination validity check](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/85e40b6dbd4b7a486e087d4007c150597942f9aa/packages/logic/src/account-review/normalization-evidence.ts#L126-L156) contributes only to a boolean, and [`prepareRow`:113–134](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/85e40b6dbd4b7a486e087d4007c150597942f9aa/packages/logic/src/account-review/normalization.ts#L113-L134) always sets `toAssignment:null`. Both **explicit named unmatched Cash**, **uncertain Cash identity**, and **true absence** then look identical to T019/T014-M. `toAssignment` encodes `existing/suggested/unresolved` decisions but cannot express grounded name/type/card/provider/candidate scope or UTF-16 evidence; encoding those into reasonCode/candidateAccountIds, legacy `transaction.toAccountId`, or a second DTO is unsafe. Therefore keep proof and choice as **two separate fields**.

### Minimal exact canonical schema proposal (NOT implemented)

Change only `packages/logic/src/account-review/review-schemas.ts`'s shared `commonReviewRow` when a future canonical-source lease exists:

```ts
accountEvidence: accountReviewAccountEvidenceSchema,
toAccountEvidence: accountReviewAccountEvidenceSchema.nullable().default(null),
currency: accountReviewCurrencySchema,
assignment: accountReviewAssignmentSchema,
toAssignment: accountReviewAssignmentSchema.nullable(),
```

Reuse the **existing inferred** `AccountReviewAccountEvidence` union; no new provider wire field, enum, copy, public DTO, group ID or financial-action payload. `accountReviewRowSchema` and `accountReviewSessionSchema` remain the authoritative strict validators. The Zod *input* admits an **omitted** legacy field; the parsed *output* always materializes `toAccountEvidence:null` (never `undefined`). Do **not** use a permissive `.optional()` output, add silent `catch` defaults on malformed objects, or change source `accountEvidence`.

Extend the existing `validateReviewDestination(row,ctx)` rules **only** as follows (future grant): for every **Voice row** and every **non-ATM SMS** row, `toAccountEvidence !== null` is a schema error on `["toAccountEvidence"]`; retain the already existing `toAssignment===null` restriction. On ATM SMS, allow `null` or a canonical `absent | explicit | uncertain` object, **never contextual SMS destination**. `explicit` retains validated source spans and account identity; `uncertain` remains uncertain with no automatic choice; canonical `absent` has exactly null identity and empty candidates/spans. The existing known-currency, assignment-currency and distinct source/destination checks stay unchanged ([review-schemas.ts:211–267](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/packages/logic/src/account-review/review-schemas.ts#L211-L267)). A user-selected, freshly revalidated destination can be an `existing(origin:"user")` assignment even with unconfirmed provider evidence, subject to existing currency/source safety; provider uncertainty never itself supplies authorization. Do **not** allow unresolved `toAssignment` in unconfirmed-currency states currently disallowed by that validator; proof can remain non-null while `toAssignment` stays null until currency is confirmed.

### Producer → resolver/adapter handoff and trust

1. **T014-P owner, later separate lease:** extend `NormalizedRowEvidence` with `readonly toAccountEvidence: AccountReviewAccountEvidence | null` and **separate source-validity from destination-validity** in `normalization-evidence.ts`; pass the result into `normalization.ts::prepareRow` alongside unchanged `accountEvidence`, financial rows, rowId, review reasons and `toAssignment`. Accept v2 ATM proof **only** after exact submitted SMS messageId/fingerprint/body or sender UTF-16 grounding, type/card/provider compatibility, owned candidate checks and no cross-message/model-ref borrowing. Invalid/foreign/currency-incompatible destination provenance must become a **blocked/sanitized `uncertain`** local proof (no bogus spans/candidates, with `account_evidence_invalid`/`cash_transfer_review` reason), **not** `null` or `absent` that would authorize a default. Preserve otherwise valid financial amount/category and independently valid source evidence. No provider retry/extra AI call.
2. **T014-M platform boundary:** use the approved actual **zero-argument** `loadAccountReviewAccountSnapshots(): Promise<AccountReviewAccountSnapshots>` ([T010:324–347](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/apps/mobile/services/account-review-read-model-service.ts#L324-L347)); **do not invent `expectedUserId` argument** from the stale T014-M plan. T010 checks scoped active owned accounts, default metadata, children and current actor; adapter retains its owner/session/generation/cancellation guards and original SMS correlation before passing typed context into pure logic. That context is **not** a DB authorization token.
3. **T019 resolver authority (after T016):** inspect local row `toAccountEvidence` **independently** of source `accountEvidence`. Grounded explicit Cash destination → match a *compatible owned active Cash* candidate or offer unresolved named choice; **never fallback** to another Cash default if explicit unmatched or ambiguous. Uncertain/invalid proof → unresolved/manual confirmation without substituting Cash default. Only *true no-evidence* (`null` or canonical `absent`) may choose one eligible matching Cash default, else the sole compatible Cash, else unresolved choice; no first Bank fallback. Require known compatible currency and different source/destination account IDs. Preserve valid explicit user choice after current-owner revalidation, without using old `transaction.toAccountId` as proof ([review-commands.md:38–55](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/specs/395-shared-account-review/contracts/review-commands.md#L38-L55)). The resolver does not generate groups/row IDs, auto-select, confirm, convert amounts or write records.
4. **Local durability/privacy:** if T028 later serializes the existing SMS v2 **local draft** review row, store this field under that already approved JSON row only with the closed schema and read missing old proof as null; do not add DB columns or overwrite v1 encoded bytes. Existing [v1 codec](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/packages/logic/src/sms-review-drafts/sms-review-draft-codec.ts#L145-L220) must remain unchanged. **Exclude** this local proof, source spans, sender text and destination metadata from financial-action cloud tuple, server payload, outbox logs, telemetry and provider **request**. The provider **response** already includes `toAccountEvidence`; no change to its v2 response schema or provider projection is needed.

## Exact T004/spec and type-compatibility deltas to request, not perform

- Amend only the **local Row** entry in [wire-shapes.md:109–127](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/specs/395-shared-account-review/contracts/wire-shapes.md#L109-L127): `toAccountEvidence: AccountEvidence|null`, defaulting omitted prior local rows to null on parse; source and destination proof independently validated; assignment and provider wire tables unchanged. Clarify [parser-evidence.md:76–107](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/specs/395-shared-account-review/contracts/parser-evidence.md#L76-L107) that validated ATM destination proof **survives normalization**, invalid proof never becomes "no destination mentioned", and ordinary rows require null. Clarify the ATM choice/default order in [review-commands.md](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/specs/395-shared-account-review/contracts/review-commands.md#L38-L55) only as the consequence of the existing grounded-identity-before-default rule. Document the field as **local-only** in the T014-M/T028 implementation notes; no material product, mockup, migration, SQL, provider, or UI change.
- **Type contract:** `z.infer<typeof accountReviewRowSchema>` / `AccountReviewRow` gains a **required output** `toAccountEvidence: AccountReviewAccountEvidence|null`; `z.input<typeof accountReviewRowSchema>` remains compatible with old omitted rows. Existing direct TypeScript `AccountReviewRow` literal builders (e.g. [schema-integrity.test.ts:185–315](https://github.com/Msg22/Monyvi/blob/9a8987a8087db886d9b9244182ef8e8128016621/packages/logic/src/account-review/__tests__/schema-integrity.test.ts#L185-L315), Core `resolution-fixtures.ts`, pending T014 normalizer prepareRow) need an explicit `toAccountEvidence:null` or parse-from-`z.input`; **do not conceal those TS errors** with casts/any/suppression. Direct object spreads preserve the new field. No field is added to `ParsedSmsTransaction` or `AccountReviewSession` root.

## Required tests-first Red before canonical-source grant

| Case | Frozen expectation / regression guard |
| --- | --- |
| **Legacy omitted/null** | Old Voice/SMS/ATM local rows and earlier codec reads parse; `toAccountEvidence` materializes `null`; original `toAssignment`, user overrides, selection, revisions and source financial fields unchanged. Malformed non-null object still fails closed. |
| **Voice and ordinary SMS** | Non-null `toAccountEvidence` rejected even with `toAssignment:null`; genuine `null` accepted. Never synthesize an ordinary transfer endpoint. |
| **ATM explicit matched** | Original message ID, UTF-16 body/sender span, supported known currency, grounded Cash name/type/card/provider and owned context survive into local row; source BANK/WALLET assignment stays separate; T019 may accept exact current owned Cash. |
| **ATM explicit unmatched** | Proof persists as `explicit` with name/spans and unresolved destination; compatible unrelated Cash default **must not** be silently selected. |
| **ATM ambiguous/uncertain** | Proof persists as `uncertain`; hard review reasons and no default/reassignment, even if one Cash default exists. Invalid/missing destination proof must not be promoted to `absent`. |
| **Bad provenance** | Rejected forged/wrong-source SMS span, cross-message alias/sender borrow, conflicting card/type/provider/candidate ID; valid financial row/category/source proof retained where safe; blocked destination evidence, no provider replay. |
| **Currency and same-account** | Unconfirmed/unsupported/currency-conflicting ATM never gets automatic destination; selected source and Cash destination cannot have the same account ID; no amount conversion. |
| **Round-trip/privacy** | T028 future local-v2 row codec preserves a valid proof, reads omitted old proof as null, and the writer rejects its presence in cloud financial-action tuples, logs and outbound request bodies. No new DB columns; no extra model call. |

Preserve all existing 65 canonical schema tests, normalization/multiplicity cases, SMS fingerprint invariant and established 19 Edge Node tests.
